comment: Read by markdown-link-check via checklist-markdown. That tool does NOT
auto-discover this file; the checklist passes --config explicitly, but
only when the file exists, so deleting it restores the unconfigured
default rather than breaking the hook.
This file is for links no CI can resolve, not for links that are merely
broken. A GitHub stars badge pointing at /stargazers is the common case
and does NOT belong here: GitHub answers 404 on /stargazers and
/watchers for every client without a logged-in browser session, so the
honest fix is to point the badge at the repository itself, which
resolves and gets checked. Silencing a link the checker could otherwise
verify defeats the point of running it.
Rate-limits unauthenticated checkers into false failures.
In-cluster Kubernetes service links never resolve from outside.
Placeholder hosts that appear in generated auth examples.
